name: mr-tof-oscillations
description: Two assertions, and the second is the point. Closed form: the flight time is the drift distance over the drift speed, 254.563540386 us, because fixing the drift distance decouples arrival from the mirrors entirely - a trap this engine already records, and asserting it here documents the decoupling rather than pretending to measure focusing. A real analyzer fixes the oscillation COUNT instead, which this model format cannot declare. Exact invariant: a static field does no net work, so total energy returns to what it was launched with - over a path crossing a declared field discontinuity 50 times, which is where an adaptive integrator can lose energy without its own error estimate noticing. The bound is a hundredfold inside ACC-4 and the measurement has teeth: the drift accumulates with reflections, 1.55e-11 at one crossing pair against 7.05e-11 at fifty, so it is not sitting at a floor.
